sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646 establishes the office (towns elect a moderator for a one-year term. Searsburg has no town website and publishes no documents online); no official source publishes the current holder, so the post is created without a membership
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Quintina Reynolds as Searsburg's Town Clerk
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town treasurer
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Zettella Penson as Searsburg's Town Treasurer

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists Searsburg's five selectboard members as five separate rows: Scott Horwath, Tony Kilbride (Chair), Chris Reynolds (Vice Chair), Christopher Reynolds, and Gary Sage. Chris Reynolds and Christopher Reynolds are printed as separate members with different addresses (1488 and 1478 VT Route 9 W) and different email addresses, and are recorded as two people; if the directory duplicated one man, the duplication is the directory's, flagged on issue #163
